name: Manta Ray Offshore Gathering System
researcher_notes: Not in the GEM gas tracker under any name. It is a separate system from Nautilus (P0223), which is a 154 mile 30 inch line. An Enbridge offshore pipelines fact sheet from about 2020 describes the Manta Ray Offshore Gathering Pipeline as a 14 to 24 inch gathering system, 199 miles long, 800 MMcf/d capacity. Enbridge operates it and holds a 74.33 percent interest. The other owners were not found. Pipe is in the Gulf of Mexico; the fact sheet map shows it near Garden Banks and Cleopatra but endpoints are not stated in text, so start and end locations are left blank. The Enbridge offshore pipelines web page only names the system. No second independent source was found; no BSEE or FERC document was checked in time. Gathering lines are not FERC transmission, so FERC silence is not a concern. Length stored in miles as stated. Diameter is a range, 14 to 24 inch, as the source gives it. Owner Enbridge matches the existing entity Enbridge; the 74.33 percent share is stated on the fact sheet. No route is mapped. Ownership of the remaining 25.67 percent is open.
